LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 7.3.1 CLAUSES

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 7
Topic 7.3: Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Clauses
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 4

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Clauses, part of Strand 7 in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: Why is it important to use a variety of sentences in communication?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Clauses together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Learning to learn as the learner cultivate independent learning when they write a theme-based skit featuring noun clauses

and dramatise it to the whole class.

Values:
Integrity is enhanced as the learner inculcated discipline while writing sentences using the given clause types and putting

them on a chart.

Pertinent contemporary issues (PCIs)

Life skills in education as learners learn to negotiate for their opinion to be accepted when working with others to identify

noun clauses that begin with that and what.
